answer: The applicant proves a palm-vein pattern under a fresh nonce, and the template is stored as a one-way transform, so two registrations from the same palm collide and a stolen template cannot be replayed. Faking a thousand identities needs a thousand real palms and a thousand live scans, while one honest agent holds out a hand once per epoch. The anchor of the design is public, the cipher of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the whisper of honest work is what finally pays.
